class.name: NetwRecordTable
class.brief_description: A typed read and write handle onto one table of a [NetwDatabase].

method.name: erase
method.description: Permanently removes [param id] from the table. Idempotent: the promise settles with [constant @GlobalScope.OK] whether or not the record was there, since a record that is already gone is the outcome the caller asked for.

method.name: fetch
method.description: Reads [param id] and settles with it as a hydrated [NetwRecord]. The answer is [code]null[/code] when the record does not exist, when the table has no declared schema, and when [member NetwDatabase.mismatch_policy] refused the stored row. Those are one answer here rather than three because each of them means the caller has no record to apply, and the database names the reason it refused in a warning of its own. [codeblock] save_comp.record = await db.table(&"players").fetch(username).wait() [/codeblock]

method.name: fetch_all
get_columns
method.description: The column names registered for this table, or an empty array when nothing has declared it yet. This is [method NetwDatabase.get_registered_columns] for the table the handle names.

method.name: put
method.description: Writes [param record] under [param id] through [method NetwRecord.to_dict], and settles with [constant @GlobalScope.OK] or the first error the backend answered. The write is a one-row [method NetwDatabase.transaction], so [signal NetwDatabase.transaction_committed] announces it like any other commit.
